plans.name: National Group
plans.summary: The whole crew, nationwide. Best if you travel between cities or are still deciding where to land.
includes: Access to the national GFIC Crew community
Online groups and forums for daily life support
Event announcements for Guangzhou, Shenzhen and the national group
Practical guides: housing, healthcare, banking, mobile payments
Language exchange groups for Mandarin and English practice

plans.name: City Group
plans.summary: One city group, with local meetups and local knowledge. Guangzhou first.
includes: Dedicated city group with local meetups and local knowledge
Local knowledge on renting, healthcare and getting around, shared by people in your city
Member pricing on food crawls, workshops and trips
Your own event ideas promoted to the city group

plans.name: Business Group
plans.summary: For founders, freelancers and anyone building something in China.
includes: Business networking mixers and partner introductions
Visibility for your own projects inside the crew
Direct line to the organizing team for collaborations

refundTerms: Once paid membership opens: anyone who has not joined an activity in their first week and has not broken the community rules can leave and get the fee back in full. There is no fee to refund today, because every group is free to join.
